decisions.rationale: All comparators were reviewed. Path containment, commit races, and frozen-cwd invalidation are neighboring checks, but none shares this anchor's worktree-resolution-and-mutation identity boundary and removed-worktree failure semantics.

The listed features govern adjacent secret, debug, background, diagnostic, or consumer-visibility lifecycles. None is the same execution-context redaction, retention, deletion, and replay-oracle contract.

Auth carry-through, account-switch invalidation, reusable approval scope, and account binding are related authority transitions, but they do not share this handoff-carried permission authority and its revocation state boundary.

Operational-action, shell, preview, and host-command contracts are plausible neighbors. They are members or adjacent execution paths, not the same host-action intake sandbox, secret, transcript, cleanup, and partial-effect lifecycle.

Request paths, include resolution, OpenSubject, serialized routes, and cwd invalidation touch identity. None defines the same normalized buffer key across path, project, worktree, remote host, and routed subject.

Catalog, imported-model, and package trust lifecycles are structurally similar but govern different authorities, activation targets, state, and failures from FileManager capability-pack interpretation.

Containment, atomic local generation, and commit races are adjacent file-safety concerns, but none owns bulk tree deletion confirmation, partial failures, dirty descendants, rollback, and multi-path serialization.
Safe-save and atomic-write comparators are related, but they do not share directory replacement or merge, live dirty-buffer, watcher, symlink-conflict, and partial-overwrite semantics.
The related items address symlink defense, containment, atomic writes, or override path validation in other operations. None is the same incoming-link copy and target-directory escape/race contract.

Privacy routing, identity-record retention, account invalidation, approval binding, and per-consumer visibility are neighbors. This anchor uniquely covers revocation effects across already-open FileManager UI and caches.

Reference trust, route restoration, and identity-native opening are adjacent. None shares OpenArtifact's linked-envelope precedence, cycle detection, missing or conflicting hop, authorization, and hash-revalidation behavior.

The neighboring records address identity privacy, account-sensitive invalidation, or shared-context visibility, not mention-picker filtering across worktree, execution role, approval scope, remote cache, and mixed roots.

These are umbrella or neighboring untrusted-content, URL, prompt, webhook, and bridge policies. None is the same rendered-preview CSP, script, local/network resource, SVG, decoder, navigation, and trust-label boundary.

Stable recovery metadata, provider recovery, command diagnostics, and diagnostic privacy are plausible neighbors. None governs FileManager open and route failure correlation, endpoint context, redaction, support copy, and retention as one lifecycle.
Each related record exposes non-behavioral validation in another authority or unit set. The FileManager F-002 through F-006 product behaviors and acceptance boundary remain distinct.
Exhaustive review found no comparator with the same core FileManager tree listing, routing, virtualization, expansion persistence, settings, and explicit failure-state contract.

Atomic generation, commit races, and Docker operation transitions are related transactional examples, but none shares F-014's copy or move failure classes, preflight, cleanup, retry, and source-state outcomes.

The related path-input features require or lack validation in different request and include lifecycles. None is the same affirmative existing-path FileSafe realpath, case-fold, alias, and fail-closed scope contract.
No comparator shares the closed BaseRunner current-plan metadata wiring and legacy context-file lineage boundary after all 219 were considered.
FileSafe security events are a related member surface, not equivalent to the enumerated core capability set spanning command blocking, write scope, sensitive access, prompt checks, and overrides.
EventRecord and FileSafe event concepts touch event authority, but neither shares the combined fail-closed canonicalization, shared guard instance, and derived-mirror authority contract.
The comparators expose concurrency or TOCTOU seams in other mutation authorities. None is the same affirmative managed-rewrite mtime-and-content-hash CAS abort outcome.
No comparator addresses the implementation-module ownership gap for FileGuard and SecurityFilter, so exhaustive comparison yields no plausible same or adjacent feature.
Containment, safety-oracle, and secret-failure validation are neighboring security tests, but not the FileSafe filesystem path and symlink regression matrix with expected boundary outcomes.

Crash-safe cache, local generation, commit-race, and governance transaction gaps are analogous but have different owners and state. None shares FileSafe parent-directory fsync, durable-success, and janitor writer-race semantics.
Concurrency proof criteria are adjacent, but they do not define the workload threshold, timeout, cancellation, ordering, and failure disposition of asynchronous guard checks.

The related records concern particular containment, atomic-write, or TOCTOU problems. They are members or analogues, not the same complete FileSafe canonical-path mutation, backup, janitor, CAS, conflict, post-write, and append boundary.
Those comparators address trust and normalization of other path inputs. None is the same affirmative FileSafe canonical request-context root comparison contract.

The shared blocked-state contract includes explainable controls and the approval UX includes accessibility concerns, but both are umbrella or adjacent surfaces rather than this exact disabled-control explanation model.

Approval freshness, operation transitions, history actions, and blocked recovery are related. None owns account-pressure state plus exact bulk target previews, authorization, stale-preview revalidation, and partial bulk completion.
Crosswalk fallback and owner-precedence gaps are governance neighbors, but none shares the FileSafe repair ordering and missing-owner-structure integrity-failure outcome.
No comparator governs the GATE-010 arrays, item shapes, requiredness, empty-state meaning, and versioning boundary; schema-related records have different authorities and consumers.

The listed approval constraints support the same security neighborhood, but none is the exact negative rule that an environment signal cannot grant destructive authority without authenticated current override evidence.

These comparators govern permission ceilings, approval replay, target binding, reuse, or stale actions. None shares the persistent exact-command principal, root, interpreter, policy, expiry, revocation, and receipt lifecycle.

Immutable approval and activation truth are adjacent parts of the Planning flow, but the comparator is broader approval/outbox/GUI state while this anchor is exactly one CAS-bound PlanCompile launch authority.
Exhaustive review found no comparator for the SQL-injection checker's grammar, normalization, dialect, outcome, and acceptance-corpus gap.

Restart preservation, action availability, approval defect handling, revalidation, and stale-action rejection are neighbors. None is the same persistent blocked-episode resolution CAS, idempotency, concurrent rerun, and resolved-versus-superseded evidence contract.

The listed records cover path trust, containment, local atomic writes, or overrides in other operations. None defines nearest-existing-parent canonicalization and race-safe creation of a new FileSafe leaf.

Credential refresh, authenticated sessions, and account invalidation are related revocation races. They do not share the trusted daemon's in-flight loss, re-pair, cancellation, reconciliation, and retry lifecycle.
Local preservation and blocked recovery are adjacent visibility patterns, but none is the same blocked or expired structured-attachment chip state with reason and audit event.

Host blocker, Doctor, readiness, and dispatch checks are neighboring fail-closed gates. None shares FileSafe's absent-scope write block, no silent disablement, and initialization and plan-list Doctor contract.

Receipt ownership, trace persistence, normalized storage, projection events, EventRecord, and debug evidence are adjacent observability pieces. None shares F2-197's deferred envelope hook, quotas, sampling, suppression, and correlation contract.

Each listed comparator is a concrete approval, operation, action, or mutation race. They are related members, not equivalent to this cross-control transition-oracle gap spanning freshness, confirmation, duplicate submission, partial mutation, rollback, and replay.

Requested/effective identity propagation and invalidation are adjacent data contracts, while this anchor owns GUI recomputation and visual separation of inherited, overridden, honored, skipped, and clamped runtime states.
Degraded blockers and failed Doctor checks are related fail-safe behavior, but neither is the FileSafe pattern-source fallback sequence that retains enforcement and emits a degraded event.
No comparator specifies the same canonical FileSafe GUI placement under Settings Advanced or the negative constraint against a standalone tab.

These features govern neighboring evidence, storage, payload, identity, diagnostic, or secret-redaction boundaries. None shares the complete pre-render RedactionSettlement ordering barrier, raw-vault authority, key custody, retention, deletion, and replay contract.

Deterministic ambiguity, research-safe classification, and approval reuse are nearby policy concerns. None is the same insecure interview default for sensitive reads and no-plan strictness lacking authenticated, scoped, expiring authority.
The comparator shares tray as a surface but governs notification destination profiles, not multi-project Pause, Resume, and Quit command scope, authority, confirmation, and race behavior.
General deterministic defaults and research safety are policy neighbors, but neither is the exact restrictive FileSafe guard, override-receipt, file-scope, and interview-sensitive-access default set.

Untrusted inputs, artifact data, OCR text, sendPrompt authority, and prompt admission are related input boundaries. None is the same affirmative structured-attachment join into the compiled-prompt pre-send gate with explicit block result and reason.

These records address path-bearing inputs, template syntax, includes, parser safety, override paths, or package files. None shares the request path-extraction grammar, normalization, bounds, URL skipping, and malformed-input oracle.
Template and XML parsing are adjacent parser surfaces only. Neither shares this concrete UTF-8 byte-offset slicing panic and its character-boundary failure semantics.
